name: Mac Auto Deafen
description: Auto deafens Discord at a set % by pressing your Discord deafen keybind. Made for macOS.

percent.name: Deafen at %
percent.description: Discord gets deafened once you pass this percent.

undeafen-on-complete.name: Undeafen on complete
undeafen-on-complete.description: Undeafen when you beat the level.

ignore-startpos.name: Ignore start pos runs
ignore-startpos.description: Don't deafen if you started from a start position.

key.name: Key
key.description: Must match the Toggle Deafen keybind you set in Discord.
